content.text: For digital creators in Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya, selling [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-how-sell-ebooks-kenya-works-how-deploy-4|How How]], courses, and templates online without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad just got a whole lot easier. With NOWPayments and the Sovereign Stack, you can collect payments in [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-2|COREMERCH guide to crypto]]currency with fees as low as 0.5% and process transactions faster than traditional payment gateways. But what does this actually mean for creators who have been locked out of mainstream payment processing [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/top-7-options-selling-digital-products-africa-ranked|options]]? The reality is that relying on these platforms means giving up to 10% of your earnings to middlemen like Gumroad. In contrast, NOWPayments charges a fraction of that – a mere 0.5% – making it an attractive option for creators looking to maximize their profits. For example, at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference retains $921, a significant sum for any creator.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-explained-digital-creators-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
